title: Handling of sales and service process
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on how sales, delivery, reception, and follow-up were handled, with most sampled fragments lacking clear overall sentiment assignment despite describing smooth or poor handling.

negative.summary: Negative feedback explicitly criticizes how issues were handled, describing the treatment as unsatisfactory or careless.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments describe sales, delivery, staff, and reception being handled smoothly or badly, but the sample is insufficient to assign a clearer overall sentiment pattern.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are assigned undetermined sentiment, which limits confidence in a clearer sentiment summary.
This topic mixes several process-related contexts such as buying, business talks, delivery, reception, and follow-up rather than one single interaction stage.
The evidence is drawn from a small stratified sample and is not representative of the whole source population.
